style: Grounded medieval European manor estate, refined storybook realism rather than cartoon or low-poly. Muted moss green, weathered limestone, dark oak, charcoal slate, warm amber windows. Physically based materials with subtle age, moss, wood grain, chipped stone and believable construction. Entire isolated architectural object, all sides complete, no terrain base, no background, no people, no text or logos.

assets.prompt: An exquisitely detailed small medieval European manor castle, symmetrical stone gatehouse, two slender round towers with steep dark slate roofs, arched oak double door, recessed leaded windows, modest ivy around the base, carved limestone cornices, small muted green banners, historically plausible proportions. A quiet inhabited country estate, not a war fortress. Front facade width about 26 meters, depth 12 meters, height 19 meters.

An exquisitely detailed medieval European village tavern, two stories, weathered pale limestone ground floor, dark oak half timber upper floor with aged warm plaster, steep mossy charcoal slate roof, brick chimney, recessed amber leaded windows, arched plank door, small covered porch, empty hanging wooden sign, a few barrels. Plausible real building proportions, front width 8 meters and depth 7 meters.

An exquisitely detailed medieval European manor courtyard fountain, circular weathered limestone basin, two elegantly carved tiers, a small acorn finial, moss around stone joints, carved floral relief, fine stone grain. Empty dry basin, no water mesh, no ground plane. Basin diameter 6 meters, total height 3.5 meters.
